listingTitle: Avoid C# string concatenation in loops
title: Avoid C# string concatenation in loops
why: Repeated immutable string concatenation can copy a growing prefix and allocate temporary strings on every iteration.
suggestion: Accumulate with StringBuilder or collect fragments and join once after the loop.
limitations: Only explicitly typed string variables whose nearest declaration precedes a multiline loop and that use += or self-concatenation are reported.
Bounded loops, compiler optimizations, variable shadowing, and alternative string-like types are not inferred.
